name: Real course 2026-11-08
description: The organizers' 3D model (dronehacks-course-v3.obj) without the maze dividers M1 to M3 and the tube cradles, plus the start-area walls and boulders from the team's sketch of 2026-11-08. Made by course_map_tools/make_real_course_map.py. Not yet measured against the built course.
